newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Five missing, one dead in Venezuela air crash.
newsitem.headline: Five missing, one dead in Venezuela air crash.

text.p: The body of an American tourist, one of six people aboard a light plane which plunged into the sea near the Venezuelan coast Sunday, was recovered Monday, rescue officials said.
An Air Rescue Service spokesman quoted by the official VENPRES news agency identified the tourist as Bradley Wood. No other details were given.
Search and rescue operations for the other missing people were continuing.
The Cessna 402 Siglas plane, reportedly owned by Chaplin Air, crashed during a short flight between Caracas Maiquetia airport and the Caribbean archipelago of Los Roques.
